verdict.rationale: Orb runs a hosted first-party MCP server that exposes 100+ API operations as tools, covering customers, subscriptions, invoices and credits. That lets an agent query the platform directly to look into a customer's invoices and subscription state, and access is scope-controlled for read-only use. The docs do not show that MRR, delinquent-account, or upcoming-renewal queries are available as agent tools. Missing for 10: documented MRR or revenue metrics exposed via the MCP server or API, explicit delinquent/past-due account queries, upcoming-renewal queries, and hands-on corroboration of agent billing Q&A.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: It exposes 100+ Orb API operations as tools, covering customers, subscriptions, plans and prices, billable metrics, invoices, credits, alerts, licenses, event search and price evaluation
You can ask an agent to look into a customer's bill, check why usage isn't showing up, model a price change, or make a subscription change
Each scope covers one area of Orb... and can be set to **none**, **read** or **write**
